prompts.sedan: Create one production photographic reference contact sheet for an automotive photography app. Exact seamless 3 columns by 4 rows grid, equal rectangular cells, no gutters, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark. Each cell is an independent realistic photograph, composed clearly with full subject in frame. Consistent modern neutral charcoal sedan interior, left hand drive, natural daylight, realistic materials. Row1 left: driver door open, cockpit visible including door opening driver seat wheel dash; middle: full dashboard viewed straight from middle rear seat, entire dash; right: close view of whole steering wheel. Row2 left: illuminated instrument cluster and odometer closeup; middle: whole driver seat photographed from open driver door; right: both front seats photographed from rear seat. Row3 left: whole rear bench photographed through open rear door; middle: center console including gear shifter and cupholders viewed downward; right: infotainment screen straight-on, generic interface no readable text. Row4 left: driver door interior panel and window switches; middle: cabin roof liner with sunroof photographed upward; right: wide infotainment screen and center console together from passenger seat. High quality actual photographic appearance, not drawings, no primitive shapes, no identifiable manufacturer marks. This is an original educational composition guide asset, not a customer inventory vehicle.
